Extract a visual style from a reference, then use it to stage a person holding a product.

**Editor adaptation · Multi-step workflow · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- A style reference and a product photo; a text model for extracting the style recipe.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>

#### Step 1

```text
Describe the reference photo as a reusable JSON style recipe: lighting, camera angle, palette, background, and photographic texture. Keep product and person identity out of the style fields.
```

#### Step 2

```text
Using the style recipe and attached product photo, create a natural photograph of a person holding the product. Preserve the product shape and visible label.
```

[View this case on Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com/prompt/community-style-reference-product-ugc?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=detail--en--style-reference-product-ugc)

</details>

### Make it your own

Follow the steps in order. Reuse prior outputs where required and check external processing before starting.

### Notes

- Editorial adaptation of the creator’s two-stage recipe. The source first analyzes the reference with GPT-6 Astra, then generates the image.
- Save the first approved character image as a reference for later variations. The source post displays a paid-partnership label.

## 中文

先从参考图提取视觉风格，再生成手持产品的人像。

**编辑改写 · 多步骤工作流 · 尚未独立测试**

### 输入要求

- 风格参考图与产品图；提取风格配方需要文本模型。

<details>
<summary>提示词</summary>

#### 步骤 1

```text
把参考照片概括为可复用的 JSON 风格配方：光线、机位、配色、背景和摄影质感。风格字段不包含产品或人物身份。
```

#### 步骤 2

```text
使用风格配方和附件产品照片，生成一个人自然手持该产品的照片，保留产品形状和可见标签。
```

</details>

### 改成你的需求

按顺序执行步骤，按要求复用先前结果，开始前确认外部处理工具可用。

### 使用说明

- 依据作者两阶段流程改写。原帖先使用 GPT-6 Astra 分析参考图，再生成图片。
- 将第一张满意的角色图保留为后续变体的参考图。原帖展示了付费合作标签。
